content.short: Stablecoin-powered cash management and card product.
content.description: Fuse is a stablecoin-powered money app that lets consumers hold, earn on, and spend digital dollars without dealing with the usual complexity of crypto. Built on Solana, the self-custodial wallet uses a multi-key design with no seed phrase, offers integrated stablecoin yield, and pairs with Fuse Pay — a prepaid Visa card that works directly with stablecoins so users can spend at merchants without manually converting back to fiat. Aimed at users in the US and globally, Fuse positions stablecoins as an upgraded everyday cash account: dollar-denominated balances that earn yield, move instantly across borders, and can be spent anywhere Visa is accepted. Its goal is to make stablecoin cash management feel like a familiar neobank experience.
content.meta: Fuse is a Solana-based stablecoin wallet with yield and a spending Visa card. Discover Fuse Wallet and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
